summary: Digital asset wealth and yield platform that suspended all activity in June 2024 and entered insolvent liquidation after losses linked to assets held through third-party hedge fund managers on FTX.
what_happened: Yield App publicly launched in February 2021 as a digital asset wealth platform offering yield products. On 28 June 2024 it announced the suspension of all platform activity ahead of liquidation, citing realized portfolio losses through third-party hedge fund managers that had held assets on FTX. Yield App Limited entered insolvent liquidation effective 1 July 2024, with joint liquidators appointed from Cork Gully LLP.
uncertainty_notes: Customer recovery remains dependent on the liquidation process, asset realizations, litigation, and claim treatment. The record does not assume that all platform customers have identical legal or recovery outcomes.
notes: Added as a post-FTX centralized yield-platform insolvency and liquidation case.
